text:
Alex Kim: quick follow-up to the metering RFC — thinking out loud about a lightweight ingress shim that emits 'delta-credit' events when we see late attribution matches. idea: keep the raw ingest path mostly untouched, but emit small joinable events consumers can use for ledger upserts.
Priya Nair: can you sketch what a `delta-credit` looks like? is it idempotent? how do we avoid double-charging when original event arrives later?
Alex Kim: good Q. sample:
```
{"type":"delta_credit","tenant_id":"t-123","fingerprint":"f_xxx","delta_tokens":42,"observed_at":"2025-03-21T14:12:00Z","origin":"ingress-shim-v1"}
```
it'd be upsertable by (tenant,fingerprint,origin) and have a deterministic sequence id to avoid dupes.
Mateo Ruiz: I'm worried about ordering hazards — if the canonical event later arrives and has a different token count, how do we reconcile? do we store both raw and delta or collapse into a single net change?
Alex Kim: plan is store both (raw event stream + delta stream) and run a reconciler that materializes final ledger rows. reconciler uses event time + watermarking and emits audit records for any corrections.
Jen O'Neill: auditability is crucial — we can't lose provenance. If we keep deltas separate we need links to original events. Also need a TTL on deltas otherwise the reconciler gets heavy.
Priya Nair: what about metrics and cost? extra events => cost. can we compress deltas (batch per tenant/fingerprint per minute)?
Mateo Ruiz: batching is fine as long as we keep monotonic sequence per shard. also, compression reduces cardinality but makes tail latency for reconciliation worse.
Alex Kim: agree. tradeoff matrix: immediate delta=better realtime accuracy, higher cost. batched delta=lower cost, slightly delayed fixups. leaning to 1-min batching by default, telemetry-driven.
metering-bot: deploy scheduled: ingress-shim-v1 -> canary on dev, test tenant t-dev
Jen O'Neill: rollout plan: canary -> measure duplicate rate and reconciliation churn -> if <0.3% promote. Also add an opt-out flag per tenant.
Priya Nair: one more: how do we expose this in billing UI? show 'adjustments' line item from delta events with audit links.
Alex Kim: yep — UI should show adjustment rows with link to audit id from reconciler. I'll put a short RFC follow-up doc in the usual docs folder and tag eng-platform.
Priya Nair: thanks — can you add a note about compaction window and permanent deletes for PII-sensitive tokens?
Alex Kim: will do. filing followup doc in ~30m. :thumbsup:
